scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Would you like to visit ^0000FFMorocc Raceway^000000?
scripts.translation:
[賽車女郎]
您想去^0000FF夢羅克賽道^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Alright, talk to me again when you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[賽車女郎]
好的，想去的時候再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Welcome to Morocc Raceway!
scripts.translation:
[賽車女郎]
歡迎來到夢羅克賽道！

scripts.text: Information
scripts.translation: 瞭解規則

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Someone must click on the Starter NPC to start the race.
scripts.translation:
[賽車女郎]
需要有人點擊發令員，比賽才會開始。

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Once the race is started, run around Morocc anti-clockwise.
scripts.translation:
[賽車女郎]
比賽開始後，請沿逆時針方向繞夢羅克跑。

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
You must reach all the checkpoints - No cheating!
scripts.translation:
[賽車女郎]
必須到達所有檢查點——不許作弊！

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Come again soon!
scripts.translation:
[賽車女郎]
歡迎再次光臨！

scripts.text:
[Race Starter]
Please stay on the Eastern side of me.
scripts.translation:
[賽跑發令員]
請待在我的東側。

scripts.text: Start Race
scripts.translation: 開始比賽

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Counting down...
scripts.translation: 倒計時...
